segments.title: Product hook
segments.screen: ProofFrame dashboard and judge recording slate.
segments.safe_narration: ProofFrame helps teams trust generated media after the prompt is over by turning each asset into a reviewable packet.

segments.title: Campaign brief
segments.screen: Campaign, audience, tone, and brief fields.
segments.safe_narration: The workflow starts with a creative brief while preserving the operational details teams usually lose.

segments.title: Generate variants
segments.screen: Generated asset ledger with provider/model evidence.
segments.safe_narration: The public demo uses deterministic mock generation; the same manifest fields are reserved for the final live Genblaze run.

segments.title: Review and approve
segments.screen: Approve, reject, search, and filter evidence.
segments.safe_narration: Every approval decision travels with the packet so downstream teams know which generated files are safe to use.

segments.title: Manifest preview
segments.safe_narration: The manifest ties each asset to its prompt, provider, model, storage key, checksum, approval state, and risk note.

segments.title: Export packet
segments.screen: Export manifest and download evidence ZIP.
segments.safe_narration: The local packet exports as a downloadable ZIP; final B2 proof must verify the same flow through Backblaze storage before public claims are upgraded.

segments.title: Close
segments.screen: Repo link, gate status, and ProofFrame title.
segments.safe_narration: ProofFrame makes generated media creative enough to move fast and traceable enough to trust.
